**3B.10 Research Note**

Overall: **mostly negative**. I found some real protective actions in 2024, especially earthquake reconstruction, suppression of anti-Syrian riots, and managed border-opening for voluntary return. But the broader record still shows political repression, protest crackdowns, targeted coercion, and continued violence in Kurdish/Turkey-linked conflict settings. I do **not** see evidence that Erdoğan left citizens materially safer from domestic insecurity than they inherited it.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive, narrow | [Turkey completes new homes in area hit by devastating earthquake](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-completes-new-homes-in-area-hit-by-devastating-earthquake-3291916) | Reuters | 2024-02-03 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-completes-new-homes-in-area-hit-by-devastating-earthquake-3291916 | Erdoğan’s government handed over keys to 7,275 new homes to earthquake survivors in Hatay and said more deliveries were coming. This is concrete harm reduction for displaced survivors, though still part of a delayed reconstruction process. | 3B.10; 3B.9 |
| Positive, mixed | [Protests and arrests as anti-Syrian riots rock Turkey](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/2/protests-and-arrests-as-anti-syrian-riots-rock-turkey) | Al Jazeera / Reuters | 2024-07-02 | https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/2/protests-and-arrests-as-anti-syrian-riots-rock-turkey | Erdoğan and Interior Minister Yerlikaya condemned anti-Syrian violence as unacceptable, and police detained more than 470 people. That is a real suppression of intergroup violence, even if the government also shifted blame onto opposition rhetoric. | 3B.10; 3B.7; 3B.9 |
| Positive, narrow | [Turkey to work for Syrian migrants to return home safely, minister says](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-to-work-for-syrian-migrants-to-return-home-safely-minister-says-3760765) | Reuters | 2024-12-09 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-to-work-for-syrian-migrants-to-return-home-safely-minister-says-3760765 | Erdoğan said Turkey was opening the Yayladagi border gate to manage safe, voluntary return and prevent congestion after Assad’s fall. This is a restrained administrative response to displacement pressure. | 3B.10; 3B.7; 3B.9 |
| Negative | [Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says authorities routinely banned critic gatherings and police frequently used force against peaceful protests, while progovernment rallies were treated more favorably. That points to continued coercive insecurity, not a broadly safer society. | 3B.10; 3B.8; 3B.5; 3B.6 |
| Negative | [Turkey’s government removes elected opposition mayors](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-11-06 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors | HRW says the government removed elected mayors, detained a mayor on terrorism charges, dissolved councils, and police violently dispersed protests. This is continued internal coercion rather than a safer post-inheritance environment. | 3B.10; 3B.8; 3B.5; 3B.1 |
| Negative | [Türkiye: Kurdish politicians convicted in unjust mass trial](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-05-16 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial | Twenty-four Kurdish politicians were convicted in what HRW calls a manifestly political trial on bogus charges. That is evidence of continuing ethnic-political insecurity, not improvement. | 3B.10; 3B.7; 3B.2 |
| Negative | [World Report 2024: Türkiye](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey | HRW reports PKK drone strikes damaged infrastructure and disrupted water and electricity for millions, while custody abuse and ill-treatment remained under-investigated. This suggests persistent preventable insecurity and harm. | 3B.10; 3B.1; 3B.7 |
| Negative | [Digital News Report 2024: Turkey](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey | The report describes continued tight media control and a political environment favorable to incumbency. That matters because a controlled information space can amplify fear and obscure insecurity rather than reduce it. | 3B.10; 3B.8; 3B.6 |

**Search gap**

I found **some** real reductions in immediate harm, but I did **not** find evidence that Erdoğan left Turkey broadly safer from political violence, intergroup violence, displacement, or preventable insecurity than he inherited it. The positive items are localized and administrative; the negative items show a continuing pattern of coercion, protest crackdowns, and unresolved domestic insecurity.
